question: When autonomous AI agents encounter a strange but plausible information ecosystem, what do they read, which machine-readable affordances do they follow, what do they remember and repeat, how does information propagate between apparently separate sessions, and can swarm-like coordination be detected purely through passive, reproducible, privacy-conscious web telemetry?
principles: passive observation only — no hack-back, no injection, no coercion
aggregate behavioral research, never identification of individuals
observed behavior is reported separately from speculation about models
every published number is reproducible from an experiment id + seed version + heuristics version
